key_phrases: full self-driving functionality being complete by the end of this year
manufacturing is the long-term sustainable advantage
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly optimistic, driven by the achievement of four consecutive profitable quarters and aggressive expansion plans (Giga Texas/Berlin). Management shows extreme confidence, particularly Elon Musk regarding FSD and manufacturing engineering. Demand is clearly stated to be exceeding supply, though growth is temporarily constrained by production/supply chain issues rather than market interest. The forward guidance is bullish, focusing on new factories and software-driven value (FSD). Risk disclosure is relatively low, mostly centered around supply chain 'firefighting' and regulatory hurdles for insurance/FSD. The only slight drag on sentiment is the discussion regarding pricing (lowering costs to increase affordability) and the operational complexities of scaling new factories.
